item.title: Court says the IRS can continue to share immigrants’ taxpayer data with ICE
item.description: A three-judge panel declined to issue a preliminary injunction at the request of an immigrant rights group.

item.title: Ukrainian envoy says US raised concerns about strikes aimed at Russia that impacted US oil interests
item.description: Ambassador Olga Stefanishyna noted the concern on the fourth anniversary of Russia’s invasion of Ukraine.

item.title: Daily Horoscope for February 25, 2026
item.description: We're gaining speed as we chase our dreams! That said, the road could be a bit rough as the Moon squares Venus, potentially making small slights feel larger than they are. Fortunately, once Luna trines enthusiastic Mars at 6:00 pm EST, we can funnel the energy of those upsets into constructive action on behalf of a better future. Any verbal spats were merely clearing the air, giving everyone space to move forward without overthinking. We can accomplish our goals without trampling our peers.

item.title: Government fines businesses over 6 deaths at Colorado dairy
item.description: Federal workplace safety regulators fined three businesses over their failure to protect six dairy workers.

item.title: Center stage: Resurgent Tarris Reed out to win marquee big-man battle vs. St. John’s Zuby Ejiofor
item.description: UConn center Tarris Reed Jr. is riding high off his 'best performance' as a Husky ahead of high stakes matchup against Zuby Ejiofor and St. John's.

item.title: With rubber shovels and grit, Mystic Seaport workers dig out historic whaling ship after snowstorm
item.description: Clearing 2 feet of snow from a driveway is backbreaking enough. Clearing it from a 113-foot-long historic whaling ship docked in the river is something else entirely.

item.title: New Hampshire resident charged in shooting at Canadian border
item.description: Prosecutors said the case is still under investigation and the FBI is taking the lead.

item.title: State of the Union offers Trump a chance to make the case for his foreign policy approach
item.description: He's making the case to Americans who are increasingly uneasy about his priorities.

item.title: Trump honors National Guard members shot in Washington
item.description: Air Force Staff Sgt. Andrew Wolfe was presented the Purple Heart medal during Trump’s State of the Union.

item.title: Army pilot wounded in Maduro raid gets Congressional Medal of Honor during Trump’s speech
